def transform(grid):
    # Split the grid at its single full-height divider. Compare mirrored? aligned
    # cells on each side; equal pairs are marked 3, unequal pairs use the
    # right-side background color inferred from its most frequent value.
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    div = next(c for c in range(w) if all(grid[r][c] == grid[0][c] for r in range(h)) and all(grid[r][c] != grid[r][0] for r in range(h)))
    left = [row[:div] for row in grid]
    right = [row[div+1:] for row in grid]
    n = min(div, w-div-1)
    right_bg = max(set(v for row in right for v in row), key=lambda x: sum(row.count(x) for row in right))
    return [[3 if left[r][c] == right[r][c] else right_bg for c in range(n)] for r in range(h)]

def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    # A full uniform row or column separates the two equal-sized panels.
    row_sep = next((r for r in range(h) if len(set(grid[r])) == 1), None)
    col_sep = next((c for c in range(w) if all(grid[r][c] == grid[0][c] for r in range(h))), None)
    if row_sep is not None:
        a, b = grid[:row_sep], grid[row_sep + 1:]
        shared = set(x for row in a for x in row) & set(x for row in b for x in row)
        color = next(iter(shared))
        return [[3 if a[r][c] == color and b[r][c] == color else color
                 for c in range(len(a[0]))] for r in range(len(a))]
    a = [row[:col_sep] for row in grid]
    b = [row[col_sep + 1:] for row in grid]
    shared = set(x for row in a for x in row) & set(x for row in b for x in row)
    color = next(iter(shared))
    return [[3 if a[r][c] == color and b[r][c] == color else color
             for c in range(len(a[0]))] for r in range(len(a))]
